calculationStatements.rationale: The explicit clauses concern exact calculation values, validation, immutable captured in-memory basis and unavailable semantics for the supported definition. They do not certify server access, source producer trust, native controls or load. AC-502 is a fixed-input Given/When/Then calculation criterion. EC-552 proves immutable captured manifest consistency; a fresh authoritative snapshot may produce a different manifest and is separately reviewed.

findings.status: repaired in candidate and controlled regression
findings.description: Ending/aborting an in-flight BEGIN could return the lease to the pool before transaction state was marked. The candidate now counts pending work before queue execution, destroys any lease with outstanding work and rejects late responses.
findings.regression: transport_helpers.test.mjs: end during delayed BEGIN destroys the lease before it can be recycled
